— Stories include colouring pages you can print and let your children color them. It’s a great activity children can do while you read to them or the next day.

BY PARENTS FOR PARENTS
Readmio is an app full of fairy tales that we have enriched with sounds. Just download the app, save a story to the library and start reading! While you read out loud, the app follows along and adds sounds at exactly the right moment. You don’t have to worry about anything, just read at a regular speed and our application will listen to you and enhance your experience. That’s it. For best results, don’t read too fast and avoid noisy environments (e.g. in the car).

A SMALL THEATRE AT HOME
Feel free to put even more into the storytelling, our sounds and music will help you. For example, try making different voices or facial expressions and make a small home theater for your children. The fairy tales have beautiful cover illustrations that will help you and your children choose what you are going to read. However, the children's contact with the mobile phone should end there. It is better to draw children's attention to you, the sounds, and the story itself.

MEANINGFUL STORIES
We created Readmio because we believe in the power of stories. They form the basis of society and help to spread and maintain wisdom. We believe that you and your little ones will enjoy the application and have many magical experiences together.

Phonics enables a blend of words and teaches them how to dissect words while improving spelling ability and increasing pronunciation. The perfect app for learn to spell, while having fun!
The Complete Smart Series consists of 6 books.
Books 1 and 2, introduced short and long vowel sounds.
Bk 1 – pg 8
Bk 2 – pg 24
Books 3 and 4, are introduced to initial and final consonant sounds.
Bk 3 – pg 27
Bk 4 – 34
Books 5 and 6, are introduced to common blends, digraphs, and word families.
Bk 5 – pg 3
Bk 6 –pg 14 and 39

Best of all, Smart Phonics is absolutely free, with no third party ads or other distractions.
Developing your skills in reading fluently is important. So make reading a fun family activity.
